verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents robust MCP client support: connecting to any MCP server, expanding agent capabilities with file systems, APIs, and business tools, and even adding/updating servers at runtime via the UI without restarts. This is corroborated by a dedicated docs page and a probe confirming the official MCP feature page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of MCP server connections working in practice, and a concrete list of 'official' vetted MCP servers beyond generic examples.
